chapters.title: The Cure That Made It Worse
Did They Really Dance to Death?

chosen_hook: Her feet were bleeding, her heart was giving out — and the doctors of 1518 prescribed exactly one thing: MORE dancing. | On-screen: DOCTORS PRESCRIBED MORE DANCING | First frame: medieval physician's quill writing a prescription on parchment, split-frame with a collapsed dancer's bleeding feet.
description:
In 1518, hundreds of people danced uncontrollably through Strasbourg — and the doctors' cure was MORE dancing. This is the true story of the Dancing Plague of 1518, history's strangest epidemic, and the ending nobody saw coming.

Honestly, the scariest part isn't the dancing. It's that the experts made it worse — and that five hundred years later, we still can't agree on how many died. Which theory do you believe: poisoned bread, or mass panic? Tell me in the comments.
